text: 敬畏耶和華是智慧的開端
principle: Planning claims must be bound to corpus evidence before any missing-glyph reconstruction is permitted.
retrievalOrder: same work + same character + compatible local context
same teacher + same work-state + same character
same teacher + compatible running-script state + same character
hardRules: Do not select the visually prettiest isolated glyph when its entry/exit behavior conflicts with the target phrase.
A copied, traced or rubbed glyph is usable when provenance is explicit.
Never silently convert an unresolved character into a generated character.
Cross-teacher evidence may teach grammar but may not be presented as that teacher's historical glyph.
Preserve the original line/column crop before deriving an isolated glyph crop.
The name group 耶和華 receives a readability gate before style scoring.
The exclusion policy for prohibited works remains upstream of canonical/public corpus admission.

敬畏耶.planningNeed: opening gravity that begins to move
candidateScoring: ability of 耶 to receive rather than interrupt momentum

耶和華.planningNeed: semantic center with maximum identity clarity

candidateScoring: density differentiation between 智 and 慧
firm but non-frozen terminal behavior at 端

rejectWhen: candidate requires decorative ligature to appear alive
candidate normalizes local variation into font-like sameness
agitation becomes uniform across the phrase

wen-zhengming.priority: bone structure and long-line rhythmic control

projectHandBinding.rule: Project Hand does not retrieve a synthetic fifth historical corpus. It selects and studies evidence through Stable Spine constraints, then records which teacher principle solved each local problem.

coverageMatrix.note: No cell may be marked resolved without a source-bound corpus record.
